description: This Java class, IgnitionMapBuilder, provides methods for calculating ignition timing advanced parameters based on engine characteristics such as chamber style, bore size, RPM, and fuel octane rating. It includes enums for chamber styles, utility functions for interpolation, and correction calculations for engine parameters.

classes.name: IgnitionMapBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for computing ignition timing parameters in an engine control context, based on engine metrics and style.

methods.name: getTopAdvanceForBore
methods.description: Calculates maximum ignition advance based on chamber style, octane rating, compression, and bore size.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation between two points.

methods.name: getAdvanceForRpm
methods.description: Returns the ignition advance value based on engine RPM, scaled by a maximum advance value.

methods.name: getInitialAdvance
methods.description: Calculates initial ignition advance based on RPM, manifold absolute pressure map, and maximum advance.

methods.name: round10
methods.description: Rounds a floating-point number to one decimal place.

methods.name: getBoreCorrection
methods.description: Calculates correction factor based on bore size.
